bills.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Education relating to "Waivers and Modifications of Federal Student Loans".

scores.rationale: Nullifies the student loan payment pause and debt discharge rule, leaving borrowers with more debt.
Cancelling broad loan forgiveness avoids a large federal cost.

bills.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the National Labor Relations Board relating to "Standard for Determining Joint Employer Status".

scores.rationale: Nullifies the NLRB joint-employer rule, making it harder for workers to bargain with parent companies and franchisors.
Spares franchisees and small contractors the shared-liability exposure of the broader joint-employer standard.

bills.title: Save Our Gas Stoves Act

scores.rationale: Blocks DOE efficiency standards for ranges and ovens.
Efficiency standards typically lower household energy use; blocking them may raise bills, though it preserves gas appliance choice.

bills.title: To terminate the requirement imposed by the Director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention for proof of COVID-19 vaccination for foreign travelers, and for other purposes.

scores.rationale: Ends the COVID-19 vaccination requirement for foreign air travelers, removing a public health entry measure.

bills.title: Secure the Border Act of 2023

scores.rationale: Restricts asylum, mandates E-Verify, resumes border wall construction and raises Border Patrol staffing.
Mandatory E-Verify adds hiring compliance work for small employers.
Expands border surveillance, staffing and air and marine operations.

bills.title: Strategic Production Response Act

scores.rationale: Ties reserve use to expanding oil and gas leasing on federal lands and offshore.
Preserves Strategic Petroleum Reserve stocks for emergencies.
Pushes more federal oil and gas leasing, but limits using the reserve to ease prices.

bills.title: Expanding Access to Capital Act of 2023

scores.rationale: Eases securities rules so startups and small firms can raise capital.
Reduces disclosure and registration requirements that protect investors.

bills.title: Federal Law Enforcement Officer Service Weapon Purchase Act

scores.rationale: Lets federal officers buy their retired service firearms.

bills.title: Reduce Exacerbated Inflation Negatively Impacting the Nation Act

scores.rationale: Requires inflation impact estimates for major executive orders.

bills.title: Middle Class Borrower Protection Act of 2023

scores.rationale: Mixed: restoring the old mortgage fee chart lowers fees for high-credit borrowers and raises them for low-credit, low-down-payment borrowers; bans debt-to-income fees.

bills.title: Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023

scores.rationale: Sets spending caps and rescinds unspent funds; CBO projected large deficit reduction.
Ends the student loan payment pause.
Narrows NEPA environmental reviews and fast-tracks the Mountain Valley Pipeline.
Speeds energy project permitting.

bills.title: CHOICE Arrangement Act

scores.rationale: Lets small employers band together in association plans and offer health reimbursement arrangements.
Adds lower-cost coverage options, though critics say association plans can offer thinner coverage.

bills.title: Financial Innovation and Technology for the 21st Century Act

scores.rationale: Critics say exemptions from SEC rules weaken investor protections.
Creates a crypto framework that moves most digital assets to lighter CFTC oversight.

bills.title: Parents Bill of Rights Act

scores.rationale: Gives parents rights to review curriculum, library books and school budgets.
Bans schools from selling student information.
Requires parental notice or consent on transgender students' names, pronouns, facilities and sports participation.

bills.title: CBDC Anti-Surveillance State Act

scores.rationale: Bans a Federal Reserve digital currency, which supporters say would enable government tracking of payments.

bills.title: DETERRENT Act

scores.rationale: Tightens disclosure and limits on university ties to countries of concern such as China and Russia.
Lowers the foreign gift disclosure threshold for universities from $250,000 to $50,000.

bills.title: Reforming Intelligence and Securing America Act

scores.rationale: Reauthorizes Section 702 foreign intelligence surveillance for two years.
Extends warrantless 702 collection and widens which providers must assist, while adding FBI query limits.

bills.title: Ukraine Security Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024

scores.rationale: Funds Ukraine military aid and replenishes U.S. weapons stocks.
About $61 billion in emergency spending outside the spending caps.

bills.title: Social Security Fairness Act of 2023

scores.rationale: Repeals the WEP and GPO, raising Social Security benefits for public pension recipients.
CBO estimated roughly $196 billion in added spending over ten years.

bills.title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the United States Fish and Wildlife Service relating to "Endangered and Threatened Wildlife and Plants; Endangered Species Status for Northern Long-Eared Bat".

scores.rationale: Removes endangered status for the northern long-eared bat.
Eases habitat restrictions on rural logging, farming and energy projects.
